verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a developer platform (Torch) with a Case Status API, a FOIA request API, developer accounts, API keys and a sandbox, so an official SDK is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions any official SDK or client library. Raw APIs and a sandbox are building blocks, not SDKs, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
